_comment: Transparent, configurable scoring weights for the deterministic destination/accommodation evaluator (Nupur's rule: weights live in config, not inline in code). Each weight is overridable per-request-independent via env SCORING_WEIGHT_<NAME>, e.g. SCORING_WEIGHT_BUDGET_FIT=0.4. The score is used only to rank ELIGIBLE options; it is never a safety or objective-quality measure.
